summary: Round 21 Testing Complete - Additional Charges Feature. All 11 backend tests passed (BACKEND-1 through BACKEND-7). Frontend tests verified FE-1 through FE-6. The additional charges feature is fully functional across Quotations, Proformas, and Tax Invoices with correct GST math including export currency (USD) zeroing out GST.

issues: Action bar has 'pointer-events-none' class which may affect button clickability - verify buttons are still clickable

seed_data_creation: Created test customers with unique GSTINs, test quotations, proformas, and tax invoices during backend testing. Created 'TEST_Packing_Playwright' additional charge during frontend testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 21 Additional Charges feature fully tested. Backend CRUD for /api/crm/additional-charges works. Quotation/Proforma/TaxInvoice create/update with additional_charges computes GST correctly. Convert flows (quotation→proforma→tax_invoice) carry additional_charges forward. Export currency (USD) zeros out GST on charges. Frontend AdditionalChargesConfig UI at /crm?tab=marketing&sub=configuration works with add/edit/delete. Quotation and Tax Invoice forms have '+ Add Additional Charge' button with dropdown and amount inputs.

BACKEND-1.details: Additional Charges Master CRUD - POST creates charge with {name, hsn_code, gst_rate}, GET lists, PUT updates, DELETE removes

BACKEND-2.details: Quotation with additional_charges - POST creates quotation with charges, response has additional_charges_total=500, additional_charges_gst=90, total_gst includes +90 over item GST

BACKEND-3.details: Quotation update preserves & recomputes additional_charges - PUT with new charges list recomputes totals correctly

BACKEND-4.details: Convert quotation→proforma carries additional_charges forward - POST /api/crm/quotations/{qid}/convert-to-proforma preserves charges and totals

BACKEND-5.details: Convert proforma→tax_invoice carries additional_charges forward - POST /api/crm/proformas/{pid}/convert-to-tax-invoice preserves charges and totals

BACKEND-6.details: Tax Invoice direct create + update with additional_charges - POST and PUT support additional_charges field with correct GST math

BACKEND-7.details: Export currency (USD) zeros out charges GST - POST quotation with currency:'USD' and additional_charges returns additional_charges_gst=0

FE-1.details: AdditionalChargesConfig UI at /crm?tab=marketing&sub=configuration - Section found with data-testid='additional-charges-config', inputs for charge-name-input, charge-hsn-input, charge-gst-input, charge-save-btn. Table shows charges with mono HSN and right-aligned GST%. Edit/delete buttons work.

FE-2.details: Quotation form additional charges - '+ Add Additional Charge' button (data-testid='add-additional-charge-btn') found. Clicking adds dropdown (additional-charge-select-0) and amount input (additional-charge-amount-0).

FE-3.details: Tax Invoice form additional charges - '+ Add Additional Charge' button (data-testid='ti-add-additional-charge-btn') found. Dropdown (ti-additional-charge-select-0) and amount input (ti-additional-charge-amount-0) present.

FE-4.details: Floating Cancel/Save buttons (Quotation) - Action bar (data-testid='quotation-form-action-bar') found with classes 'sticky bottom-3 z-20 mt-3 flex justify-end gap-2 pointer-events-none'. Cancel (quotation-cancel-btn) and Save (quotation-save-btn) buttons present.

FE-5.details: PDF Print template - PDF preview dialog opens with iframe. Print/Save as PDF and Download PDF buttons present.

FE-6.details: Page X of Y globally - CSS rule @page { @bottom-right { content: 'Page ' counter(page) ' of ' counter(pages); } } present in /app/frontend/src/utils/printHeader.js letterheadCSS function. Note: visible only in actual print preview (Ctrl+P), not in iframe preview.

regression_notes: Existing PDF generation works for quotation/proforma/tax invoice. Floating buttons don't block clickable form content (buttons have pointer-events-auto). Quotation total math is correct with both global discount AND additional charges combined.
